maya (PM): quick planning note 11: need a lean request/response schema for launch. priorities: small payload, explicit token fields, and deterministic tracing so customers can correlate logs across services.

sam (API): Agreed. Mobile-first customers keep bringing up payload size. We should prefer flattened keys over nested objects.

linda (Eng): For compactness, propose all telemetry keys start with tele_. e.g. tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_cost_micros. That keeps parsers predictable.

rahul (ML): Naming: prefer prompt/completion rather than request/response to match model team vocab. Also include tele_total_tokens for quick checks.

maya (PM): OK: tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_total_tokens (server can compute if missing).

noah (DevEx): Also recommend tele_cost_micros and tele_cost_currency defaulting to USD if omitted, but keep cost unit explicit: tele_cost_unit = "micros". SDKs will present human-friendly units.

sam (API): Routing hint: include tele_route with short identifiers (hosted, dedicated-v2). Make it optional. Servers may override.

linda (Eng): Trace propagation: prefer compact hex 16-char trace_id at top-level to save bytes. Optional parent_id for span linking. We'll document generation best practices.

rahul (ML): Concern: entropy for collisions with 8-byte ids. Suggest we recommend clients include an optional client_request_id when available, but don't require it. Server will append its own span id when ingesting.

maya (PM): Decision: require trace_id (16 hex chars). parent_id and client_request_id optional. Add note: clients should avoid embedding PII in ids.

noah (DevEx): Tool calls: tradeoffs between readability and size. Two options: 1) flat suffix keys (tele_tool_0_name, tele_tool_0_status, tele_tool_0_out_bytes) limited to N entries, or 2) a compact array of short maps. I prefer flat suffix keys for simplicity in log indexing.

sam (API): Flat suffixes work for our gateways; set default cap = 5 and reject extras with a clear header. That bounds worst-case payload.

linda (Eng): We'll implement gateway enrichment to populate server-calculated telemetry (tele_total_tokens, tele_cost_micros) so clients don't have to. Gateway will also normalize trace ids if clients send UUIDs.

rahul (ML): For embeddings and rerank endpoints: use emb (array) and emb_dim. For rerank responses: rank_score (float), rank_position (int). Keep names short.

maya (PM): Good. Now launch scope and gates: minimal v1 requires:
- compact telemetry keys defined (tele_*),
- SDKs map keys to friendly names (py/ts/go),
- docs with short examples and migration notes,
- gateway enrichment enabled in canary,
- telemetry pipeline accepts new keys.

noah (DevEx): I'll own SDK mapping checklist and examples. Need explicit mappings for each language + compatibility shim.

sam (API): API behavior: missing optional tele_* fields are OK. Server will fill what it can. If client-provided values contradict server calculations, server values win and we emit a warning header.

linda (Eng): Implementation timeline proposal: week A - finalize key names and max lengths; week B - gateway enrichment + logging; week C - 1% canary + partner testing; week D - full rollout. Ops must approve log schema change window.

rahul (ML): Add CI regression check: token accounting tests ensuring tele_total_tokens == prompt+completion within 1 token for tokenizer edge cases. Also monitor rank_score distributions for rerank regression detection.

maya (PM): Launch checklist items (must-have):
- Spec doc published and reviewed by eng/ML/DevEx
- SDK mappings done for core languages
- Canary completes with no token-regression alerts for 48h
- Telemetry pipeline updated (SRE signoff)

sam (API): Security note: client_request_id and parent_id can indirectly leak data if customers include PII. Add guidance in docs: prefer opaque random ids; treat ids as sensitive for retention policies.

noah (DevEx): Example payloads to include in docs (short):
{ "id":"req_01","trace_id":"b3f9a0c4d1e2f3a0","tele_prompt_tokens":10,"tele_completion_tokens":25,"tele_cost_micros":1500,"tele_route":"hosted" }

and chat+tool example:
{ "id":"req_02","trace_id":"c2a1b3c4d5e6f789","tele_prompt_tokens":6,"tele_completion_tokens":9,"tele_tool_0_name":"web_fetch","tele_tool_0_status":"ok","tele_tool_0_out_bytes":512 }

(linda) We'll add validation on ingress and a warning header for oversized traces.

maya (PM): Prioritization: this is a medium-high customer-driven initiative. Blockers: major customers with custom logging pipelines will need migration docs and a short opt-out window. Plan the partner canary early.

sam (API): I'll circulate a compact spec w/ exact types and max lengths by EOD today.

ops-bot: scheduled-maintenance: gateway v1.12 rollout window 2026-04-02T02:00Z (canary available).

maya (PM): Thanks team. Action items: sam - spec, noah - SDK checklist & examples, linda - schedule canary infra + validation, rahul - CI regression tests. Reconvene Thu for signoff. :rocket:
